title: The ram beat gets its own camera and drops its bodies ahead of the hull, so the MORK is in frame driving into them
context: The still of the merged four-beat intro (2026-09-24-intro-four-beats-built, evidence line 'still not read') showed the swarm, the splats and the '+11 kg x220' combo with NO TANK: beat C borrowed the GAME's chase camera, which sits wallHeight*2.6 + cellSide*1.1 + unitScale*1.8 above and only cellSide*1.8 behind the hull and looks a cell and a half AHEAD — ndc y -0.43 on desktop, and off the bottom edge once the hull has grown on 100+ kills. The same still had a grey boulder mid-frame: the SEALED-BREACH RUBBLE CAP (src/breach-rubble.js, 24 grey dodecahedra). The beat opens on the lane at a breach (`lane`) which the sector seals under it — breaches=0 by the beat's midpoint — so the cap piled up on that very lane with the hull inside it, which is why the hull could not be seen even where it was.
outcome: Beat C owns its shot. src/domain/showcase-shot.js (new, pure, no THREE): `ramShotPose` puts the eye 2.6 cells BEHIND and wallHeight*1.4 + unitScale*1.1 above the hull and looks at a point 2.2 cells ahead, wallHeight*0.8 off the ground — a 22.5 deg look down onto the hull against a 9.2 deg axis, which lands it at ndc y -0.40 at the game's 68 deg vertical field: the lower third, nose into the frame, with the band 2-5 cells ahead filling the middle. `cellsAhead` returns the open cells 2..5 cells along the heading and within 1.6 cells of the lane, nearest first. td-tab checks the beat's pose in updateCameraGoal BELOW the seats, deploy and cinematic shots (so the finale's closeup still outranks it) and ABOVE the gameplay views; the view stays 'third' because the DRIVE is gated on it and a hull that is not driving rams nothing. New hook `showcase.ram(on)` turns it on, re-snaps after each placement, and hides the sealed caps (breach-rubble `show`, game-breaches `rubbleShow`) for the length of the beat; `showcase.drop(n,'ahead')` spawns through the same guard path onto cellsAhead instead of round the hull, so there is something to drive INTO. The rail's beat is now lane, ram, drop 40 at the breach, ramNext, drop 26 ahead — then every 0.6 s ramNext, drop 16 ahead, ram. The counters carry hullX/hullY/hullZ (the hull projected into the camera) and the --showcase step asserts the hull is in frame at the beat's MIDPOINT and again 0.8 s before its cut, with a second screenshot there. src/td-tab.js is unchanged at its 13,505-line budget.
alternatives: Running the beat from a cinematic shot (startShot/poseAt), as the breach beat does: a shot latches the camera AND suspends the drive (`driving` requires !shot), and a hull that does not drive registers no ram. The pose had to be an override inside updateCameraGoal instead.

Retuning the game's own third-person offset so the hull rides higher: it is the gameplay camera for every seat-less minute of the game and was tuned against the phone shell (builds 1974eb11, 2d6b2444). A montage beat is not a reason to move it.

Leaving the bodies round the hull and only moving the camera: the hull is then already among them on the first frame and there is nothing ahead to drive into — the shot reads as a tank standing in a crowd, not a ram.

Keeping the rubble and steering the hull away from sealed caps: the cap lands where the breach was and the breach is where the beat's lane is, so every placement would have had to dodge it. The cap is dressing with no part in this shot and is simply hidden while the beat's camera is up.
evidence: scripts/browser-lock.sh node scripts/browser-test.mjs --showcase: PASS on all four beats and every page-level step. SHOWCASE tank-ram midpoint: hull at ndc 0,-0.4 (z 0.786) alive=150 rams=112; near the cut: hull at ndc 0,-0.4 alive=214. SHOWCASE proof: labels=4 emerging=62 rams+115 combo=115 gunRounds+100 horde=342 — every existing assertion unchanged and met.

Looked at both stills: artifacts/browser/showcase-tank-ram.png and artifacts/browser/showcase-tank-ram-late.png show the MORK centred in the lower third, nose into a wall of bodies that fills the middle of the frame, the combo readout beside it, and no boulder anywhere.

test/showcase-shot.mjs (new): the pose lands the hull between ndc -0.15 and -0.55 and strictly HIGHER than the game's chase pose on the same hull, the eye is behind and below the chase eye, bodies 2/3.5/5 cells ahead land in the middle band, and cellsAhead is ahead-only, on-lane, nearest-first, heading-relative and respects the open() gate.
npm test (122 programs) and npm run check (architecture: 90 pure-layer modules, line budgets hold, src/td-tab.js at 13,505) green; the browser step --grow green.
